priceHint: Sale prices in USD; monthly rents in USD. Mixed price sorting groups sales before rentals without comparing sale prices and rents. Select Search to apply.
rangeError: Enter nonnegative values with minimum no greater than maximum. Bedrooms and rooms must be whole numbers.
localNotice: Local demo only: nothing is sent to a server. Files are lost on reload, language change or leaving the page. Fictional illustrations are not selected photos.
photoHelp: Up to 20 photos in total per property, JPEG / PNG / WebP, 10 MiB each. Each batch is accepted or rejected in full.
documentHelp: Up to 10 PDFs in total per property, 20 MiB each. Only names and sizes are shown: no content viewer or antivirus scanning.
